target_customer: Job seekers (free) and employers who pay 10% of first-year base salary on a hire
problem: Job search is noisy with ghost and duplicate listings, and employers receive long unreasoned candidate lists.
business_model: success fee of 10% of first-year base salary paid by employers, free for candidates
product_category: AI job matching and recruiting agent

founders.name: Gaurav Luhariwala
previous_startups: Tejas AI (AI for banks to update credit rules, per YC page)
D2C conversion product sold to 30+ brands while in college (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led Product and Business at Tartan and grew revenue 8x in a year; education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating listings, LLM matching and resume rewriting is mostly standard engineering with LLM APIs; scale of ingestion is the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Matching and resume tailoring are easy to copy and well-funded AI recruiting startups were entering the space. No data or network lock-in is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against the company is documented.

market_need_then: Job seekers complain about ghost listings and the company positions against that; no spend or demand figures were found.

identity.visual_style: Clean minimal site with chat-style mockups and italic emphasis

rebrands.why: Product moved from bank risk decisioning to job search; per a yespress profile snippet, not opened

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand evidence beyond the site. Name origin is not stated anywhere found.

pivots.from: Tejas AI, AI credit policy updates for banks
pivots.to: Elip, AI job agent and shortlist service
pivots.why: not stated; inferred from the YC page listing Tejas AI as prior company and a yespress snippet on the rebrand

outcome_analysis: Elip is active with a four person team and no verified funding or traction figures. It competes in an AI recruiting field where better funded startups launched during 2025. The success fee model aligns incentives but depends on hires closing, and nothing public shows hires or revenue yet.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed but describes a different product (CRM sales nurturing), so treated as unreliable and unverified; not recorded as a round. Dated competitor search found only post-batch entrants (Jack & Jill seed Oct 2025, Juicebox, Paraform), so the list is empty. YC page does not list founder education.
